E1273

Package build failed at a logged step.

What

Package build failed at a logged step.

Why

D-JPK-BUILDDBG1 preserves the failed build scratch under the hangar and records each recipe step's command/output. The primary error names the failed step instead of dumping provider noise.

Fix

Run `jet logs <pkg>` for the full per-step log, or rerun the build with `--shell-on-fail` to debug inside the preserved scratch.
